prediction: rule fixed in advance in jobs/c3/batch52.yaml (B); no prediction

groups.B: the description's last token in the question (his edit site)
groups.E: the bridge entity's last mention in the passage before the question

rank_sets.bridge: the bridge entity (51.12's: the first token of each variant of its name)
rank_sets.ans: the reader's answer word (51.12's A-style tokens; decides)
rank_sets.ans_S: S's answer word on O (a same-type distractor; baseline)
rank_sets.tokA: the answer token as read (main: the digit)
rank_sets.bridge_whole: the bridge entity, whole-word variants only (no fragment such as 'I' for 'Iota')
rank_sets.ans_whole: the answer word, whole-word variants only (no fragment such as 'G' for 'Greece')

rule.readable: “Readable”: the answer word in the lens top-5 on ≥ 0.5 of items at some layer before the answer layer.
rule.usable: “Usable”: writing its directions changes the answer on ≥ 0.3 of items with the random control ≤ 0.10.
rule.combinations: Report the four combinations per reader, per dataset.

arms.whole: Δ = h_S - h_O added at the cell (the whole state patched; the upper bound, beside)
arms.ans1: s u: u the unit sum of the J++ lens directions of S's answer word's tokens, s = ||Δ|| at the cell
arms.rand1: s u R^T (R: X0's random basis at the layer, seed 888 + layer): a random part of the same size
arms.freq1: s u_F: F per answer token one unrelated letter token, BPE id within a factor 2, closest J++ readout norm

cell_rule: per reader the (group, layer) before the answer layer with the largest share of items whose answer word is in the J++ top-5 (ties: lower median rank, earlier layer, B < E < Q < T), point estimates
size: s = ||h_S - h_O|| at the cell; below 0.001 x ||h_O|| (the position precedes the change): the bridge word's ||Δ|| at that layer (flagged)
